title: Interior materials feel cheap or mark easily
summary: Feedback centers on interior material quality, with complaints about cheap-feeling trim, easy scuffing or staining, and fingerprint-prone surfaces, while many examples are too vague to classify beyond general dissatisfaction.

positive.summary: One positive review still notes the visor feels cheap, so the favorable sentiment is weak and narrowly framed.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe hard plastics, seats and trim that scuff, stain, soil, or collect fingerprints easily, making the interior feel lower quality and harder to keep clean.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention cheap-feeling, questionable, or disappointing interior materials and finishes, but many are brief or comparative and do not clearly establish sentiment strength.

limitations: Most sampled examples are undetermined, which limits confidence in a sharper sentiment characterization.
Several undetermined fragments are brief, comparative, or loosely tied to interior quality, so the topic includes some ambiguity in how strongly material complaints are expressed.
The sample is stratified and not representative, so it should not be used to infer broader prevalence beyond these reviews.
